note: The two-arm construction for the momentum book's ONE holdout read. Frozen before the fixture is touched. The runner refuses --read unless this file exists.
universe: keep_v2 floor, F0 deal filter, lagged, cross-sectional percentile within the fixture's own eligible names
entry: not held AND rank > 95 AND gate open
cap_status: a DECLARED holding-period constraint set by the principal, not a tuned parameter
exit_rank_status: single value; D367 measured the 80/90 gate-state split at 0.02 bp/bar, so it is not a degree of freedom
hedge: short the eligible universe, dollar-volume weighted, REBUILT on whatever universe is traded (D370)
costs: per-trade round trip (own half-spread at own entry and exit bars + commission at own as-traded price), plus hedge borrow at GC 50 bp/yr and measured rebalancing

arms.name: S6
arms.gate: all nine conditions; equivalently C9 AND C4, the other seven being logically entailed or inert
arms.in_sample_standing: clears its own rotation at 32.9 SE, best-of-ten multiplicity at 32.3 SE, symmetric winner-removal at 10.3 SE

arms.name: C9
arms.gate: the index at a 252-bar high, alone
arms.in_sample_standing: clears its own rotation at 3.2 SE; UNRESOLVED against multiplicity at -1.0 SE, where the margin equals its own standard error

multiplicity: TWO arms on ONE read is two tests: each must clear the p97.5 of its nulls, a Bonferroni split of alpha = 0.05. The unadjusted p95 is reported beside and labelled.
nulls_per_arm: GATEROT (gate circularly shifted, on-share and circular run-length multiset preserved)
APRIME (per-name time rotation within eligible bars)
hurdles: H2 above the p97.5 of BOTH nulls
H3 symmetric 1% trimmed mean per trade > per-trade round trip
H4 no single trade above 10% of ledger P&L
H5 at least 10 names to half the P&L
h4_note: H4 is RETAINED although the in-sample book fails it at 11.7% (GME, 2020-11-16). Dropping a hurdle the candidate is known to fail is tuning the hurdle to the candidate.
